rules.title: Ship Channel closures
rules.text: When the Coast Guard closes the Houston Ship Channel for fog or other safety reasons, the closure is a port closure. Time lost to a port closure is excepted from laytime.

rules.title: Holidays
rules.text: Days listed in the port calendar as holidays are non-working days for laytime.

rules.title: Terminal hours
rules.text: Terminals at the Houston Ship Channel work around the clock. Saturday afternoon and Sunday are not port holidays.
